title: abronia umbellata subsp. insularis
intro: Abronia umbellata subsp. insularis, commonly known as Channel Island Sand Verbena, is a plant species native to the Channel Islands of California, USA. This plant is known for its delicate white or pink flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Abronia umbellata subsp. insularis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
